text:
lina.partnerships: Quick sync. Kevin sent an onboarding packet with SKU churn notes + spot reliability by region. We need verified numbers for our cost model: churn rate (monthly SKU deprecations), reserved lead time, spot eviction hourly distribution, and guaranteed capacity carve-outs.
jordan.cloud: for marketplace mapping i need stable SKU IDs and a deprecation policy. if an SKU is deprecated mid-contract what are the replacement guarantees?
kevin.supplier: short answer: for marketplace SKUs we give 30d notice and an automatic mapping to a comparable SKU; for enterprise carve-outs we negotiate explicit replacement SLAs. churn historically ~3% mo for experimental SKUs, <0.5% mo for GA SKUs.
lina.partnerships: good, please include a "GA vs experimental" tag on the CSV so platform can auto-link replacements. also include region codes.
kate.finance: (jumping in) finance needs: effective $/GPU-hr under three scenarios: baseline (reserved as-provisioned), spot-weighted (mix using historical evictions), and emergency-fallback (when we spill to on-demand reserved). please provide: reserved_hourly, spot_median_hourly, spot_95p_hourly, eviction_mean, eviction_95p, min_monthly_commit, early_term_fee_pct, churn_rate_monthly.
kevin.supplier: will provide those. a couple clarifications: 1) our spot pricing is dynamic; median is set per-day. 2) eviction stats: we can supply per-hour counts for last 120 days.
jordan.cloud: platform note: include an "equivalence" column (A100-80gb-equivalent) and a perf bucket (inference throughput per-second at seq128) so teams can map instance to token-cost.
lina.partnerships: also call out any cross-region parity: some SKUs only available in us-west-2 due to inventory. we must mark that so cost model doesn't assume region fungibility.
kevin.supplier: noted: us-west-2/us-east-1/eu-central are full parity; ap-northeast-1 is partial; ap-southeast requires pre-order. lead times: standard reserved <3w, enterprise carve-outs 6-10w.
kate.finance: for Monte Carlo we prefer a simple eviction model input: hourly_eviction_prob_series (CSV) + 95p/hourly_eviction. also want the marketplace fee % to compute net.
kevin.supplier: marketplace fee is variable by channel; publish net rates in the CSV net_of_marketplace_fee column.
jordan.cloud: product question: for reserved contracts do vendors allow changing capacity mix mid-commit (e.g., move 10% from A100 to H100-equivalent)? we need flexibility flags.
kevin.supplier: flexibility options: locked (no changes), swap-on-quarter (ability to change at quarter boundaries) for a small admin fee, and fully-flex for top-tier enterprise. will annotate in CSV.
lina.partnerships: marketing/legal: any restrictions on joint announcements tied to pricing/promos? we need to ensure we can publish case studies referencing lower unit costs.
kevin.supplier: standard NDA/PR review window is 7 business days for co-branded announcements. special promos require 10d advance.
bot-marketplace: FYI SKU sync job next run: 2026-07-02T02:00:00Z.
kate.finance: action items from finance side: 1) once CSV is in, i'll run P10/P50/P90 cost bands and include a "min-commit impact" scenario (if monthly minimum forces purchase of idle hours). 2) share assumptions doc for retry multiplier and overhead.
jordan.cloud: platform action: map CSV -> instance types; add region flags; flag non-fungible SKUs; simulate fallback spill behavior (cost shock when spot evaporates).
kevin.supplier: supplier action: upload CSV with sku_id, region_codes, reserved_hourly, spot_median, spot_95p, eviction_series_reference, ga_flag, churn_rate_monthly, min_monthly_commit, early_term_fee_pct, lead_time_weeks, flexibility_flag, net_of_marketplace_fee, announcement_review_days by EOD Friday.
lina.partnerships: thanks. i'll track in the partnerships board. please @mention me when the CSV is uploaded. :white_check_mark:
kevin.supplier: will do.
lina.partnerships: one final ask: can you also provide a sample billing reconciliation report (anonymized) so finance can validate how preemptions and retries appear on invoices?
kevin.supplier: yes, can provide an anonymized month with columns: provisioned_hours, actual_hours_used, preempted_hours, replacement_hours, billed_amount, adjustments.
kate.finance: perfect. i'll schedule a short follow-up after i run the numbers.
lina.partnerships: great. closing thread once CSV is in. thanks all. :sparkles:
